description:
Search the SWATGenX I/O reference — model bundle layout, SWAT+ input files, PFAS
    fate-and-transport inputs, engine run modes and NetCDF output, MODFLOW-6 coupling,
    calibration artifacts, service limits. Returns ranked articles, each with a matching
    snippet and its chapter slug. The schemas are transcribed from the engine readers/writers
    and include the SWATGenX extensions, which stock SWAT+ documentation does not cover.
name: search_docs
title: Search the SWATGenX documentation
